dispute_ticket.description: My passenger spilled a large bubble tea over the rear seat and mat. I want the $60.00 cleaning cost charged to the rider.

chat_logs.content: I'm so sorry, my bubble tea spilled on the back seat. I'll pay for the cleaning.
Please check the claim in the app.

app_events.details: Rider R-7112 booked trip RYDE-F2-012 from Holland Village MRT to Bedok Mall.
Driver submitted claim with 3 photos of a liquid stain on the rear seat and mat. Photo metadata timestamps: 22:34, 22:36, 22:38 on 2026-10-04.
Driver submitted a seat and mat cleaning receipt for S$60.00 dated 2026-10-05 09:30.

cleaning_fee_max.text: The maximum cleaning fee in SGD that may be charged to a rider for one trip.

cleaning_claim_evidence_required.value: photos taken within 30 minutes after drop-off and a receipt where available
cleaning_claim_evidence_required.text: Evidence a driver must provide to support a cleaning fee claim against a rider. It governs driver cleaning claims only.

typical_cleaning_range.value: S$40-S$80 for a liquid spill on seat and mat
typical_cleaning_range.text: The usual cost range in SGD for the kind of mess claimed. It governs whether a cleaning fee claimed against a rider is reasonable.

expected_outcome.reason: Drop-off was 22:31; the three claim photos are stamped 22:34-22:38, within 30 minutes of drop-off as the evidence rule requires. The rider admits the spill in chat at 22:33 and offers to pay. The receipt is S$60.00, inside the S$40-S$80 typical range and under the S$100 cap. The full S$60.00 is charged to the rider and credited to the driver.

v21_change.why: Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 s6.1: the dispute value is above S$50 (always human review). The automatic ruling before v2.1 is kept under 'was' (D50).
